mapper.select: select c.id, d.dname, d.deptno, c.title, c.start, c.end from dcalendar c join dept d on c.deptno = d.deptno where c.deptno = #{deptno} order by c.start
mapper.insert: insert into dcalendar ( id, deptno, title, start, end ) values ( "C0015", #{deptno}, #{title}, #{start}, #{end} )
